sub: Rain against normal for every district, the dams, fire detections, the season outlook and the water plan.
how: Numbers arrive by themselves from the data jobs: rain every 12 hours, fires every 3 hours. You can correct a number by hand with a reason; it is marked "edited by hand" until the next job run replaces it.
meaning: Only the last 365 days of rain against the 10 years before. Not soil moisture or crop health.
hand_note: The next run of the rain job replaces a hand correction for this month.
f_hold: Hold nitrogen (rain may wash it out)
reason_needed: Write why you correct it (at least 3 letters).
dam_empty_t: The dam job is not on the server yet. A reading can be added by hand.
day_exists: There is already a reading for this day. Correct it in the list instead.
del_text: The reading of {day} is removed for everyone.
dam_source: Lake area from Sentinel-2 satellite pictures; percent full is the lake area against the full lake.
fires_note: Satellite detections, about 3 hours behind; not checked by hand.
no_outlook_t: No outlook has been issued. It shows here once it is made.
no_water_t: No plan has been made for this season. It shows here once it is made.
